item.title: London rivals Arsenal and Chelsea meet tonight in the first leg of their Women's Champions League quarter‑final tonight.
item.description: Holders Arsenal are without captain Leah Williamson through injury. Chelsea’s Aggie Beever‑Jones faces a late fitness test, while skipper Millie Bright and Sam Kerr are among those ruled out.

item.title: A group which organised celebrations to mark Motspur Park station’s 100th anniversary has won a national award.
item.description: The Community Rail Awards recognise people working on behalf of their communities and railways. The Motspur Park series of celebratory events included talks and a model railway exhibition. The judges praised the project for helping connect people with their station and for leaving a positive, lasting impact.

item.title: As Surrey prepares to head to the polls at the Local Elections, residents are being reminded of one big change.
item.description: Because of Devolution, which is taking place in April 2027, people will not see their normal constituency on their ballot paper on May the 7th. Surrey's 11 district and borough councils are to be abolished. Instead, residents are voting for their district which will eventually lie in either West Surrey or East Surrey Unitary Authority. item.title: Flood defence measures are being installed at a number of council homes in a part of Hammersmith.
item.description: It’s after residents living in Lorne Gardens saw their street flooded in January after a watermain burst at Holland Park Roundabout. Thousands of litres of water was pumped out downhill every minute and twenty-seven properties were affected. Hammersmith and Fulham Council has confirmed funding for the project and secured contributions from Thames Water and Peabody.

item.title: Surrey County Council is terminating two further critical support services at Leatherhead based Crossroads Care Surrey.
item.description: The charity says both the Emergency Care Provision and the End of Life support service have now been withdrawn. item.title: The former host of Never Mind the Buzzcocks has been banned from driving.
